Because I've watched what happens after nine years of that pill.

My mother took MiraLAX every morning for fifteen years.

She died at 67 of sepsis from a bowel impaction nobody saw coming.

Last month my doctor handed me the same prescription and I almost filled it.

The paper sat on my kitchen counter for nine days. Next to my keys. Folded once down the middle. I walked past it every morning on my way to the coffee pot and pretended I wasn't seeing it.

I'm 49. I live alone. There is no one else in this house to ask me what the prescription is for or why I haven't filled it.

That part matters.

My mother was a quiet woman.
